verses.text: Ha nok' chan, yelxo wal te jelan nok' t'a yichanh masanil nok' k'ultakil nok' ix sb'o Jehová Dios. Ix yalan nok' t'a ix ix: --¿Tom yel ix yal Dios to max yal he loan sat masanil te' awb'en te' tik? xchi nok'.
Ix tak'wi ix t'a nok' icha tik: --Masanil te' syal ko loan sat,
anhej jun te' ay t'a snanhal te' awb'en te' tik, ix yal Dios to max yal-laj ko loan sat te', ma ko yamani, yik wach' max onh chami, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi nok' chan chi' t'a ix: --Tonhej syal Dios chi'. Manh ol ex chamlaj.
Palta yojtak Dios, ayik ol he loan sat te' chi', ol tz'akwok he pensar, lajan ol ex ajkan yet'ok, ol nachajel wach'il yet' chukal eyu'uj, xchi nok' t'a ix.

Haxo ix yilanoch sat te' chi' ix, te wach' am sloji, te wach' yiljiochi, ix snib'anoch ix, yik wach' stz'akwiel spensar ix sna'ani. Yuj chi' ix sb'ixanelta jun sat te' chi' ix, ix sloan ix. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anpax ix t'a winh yetb'eyum chi', ix sloanpax te' winh yet' ix.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix nachajel yuj heb', ix yilanoch sb'a heb' to b'eranel heb', yuj chi' a xil te' higo ix smol heb', ix stz'isan heb' spichulok, yik tz'och t'a snanhal heb'.

Haxo ix yab'an winh winak chi' yet' ix ix chi' to wan yek' Jehová Dios t'a skal te awb'en te' chi' t'a yemxok'uhalil, yik sikxo k'u, ix el lemnaj heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'ay t'a skal te awb'en te' chi'.
Haxo ix awtaj winh yuj Jehová Dios: --Ach Adán, ¿b'ajtil ayach ek'i? xchi.
Ix tak'wi winh: --Ina wajek' tik, ix wab'i to wan ek' t'a skal te' awb'en te' tik, ix in xiwb'ati yujto b'eran in eli, yuj chi' ix in k'ub'ejel in b'a, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'an Dios t'a winh: --¿Mach ix halan t'ayach to b'eran ach eli? Tope ix a lo sat te te', te' ix wal t'ayach to max yal-laj a loani, xchi t'a winh.
Ix tak'wixi winh icha tik: --Ha ix ix, ix ak' wetb'eyumok, a ix, ix ak'an te' t'ayin, yuj chi' ix in lo te', xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'an Dios t'a ix: --¿Tas yuj icha chi' ix a k'ulej? xchi. Ix tak'wi ix: --Ha nok' chan in ak'an musansatil, yuj chi' ix in lo te', xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová Dios t'a nok' chan chi': --Yujto icha tik ix a k'ulej, yuj chi' tzach in katab'ejkan t'a skal masanil nok' molb'etzal nok' yet' nok' k'ultakil nok'. T'a junelnhej a yalanh a k'o'ol ol nherwok. Ha spokokal lum lum ol a lo'o.
Ol wak'kanoch ajk'olal t'a a kal yet' ix ix tik yet' masanil inhtilal yet' pax yinhtilal ix. Ha yinhtilal ix chi' ol mak'anpoj a jolom. Ha ach xo, ol a chi yich yok yinhtilal ix chi', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Dios t'a ix icha tik: --Ol wak' a yahelal ayik yab'ix ach, haxo yik ol aljok une', ol wak'an niwtaj a yahelal chi'. Wach'chom ay yahelal ol ila', ol a nib'ejnhejoch winh etb'eyum. Ha winh ol och ajalok, xchi Dios.

Ix yalanpax Jehová Dios t'a winhaj Adán chi' icha tik: --Yujto ix a k'anab'ajej ix etb'eyum tik a loan sat te te' ix wala' to max a lo'o, a tikne'ik jun, u'uj tzin katab'ejkan lum lum tik, yuj chi' t'a skal yahelal ol ach waok yakb'an ayach ek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ol k'ib'cha'anh te' k'i'ix yet' anh ank'ultak ay sk'ixal t'a sat lum lum tik. Ha yuj juntzanh awal inhat ol ik'an yek' tiempo eyu'uj.
Ol el alil a munlaji, icha chi' ol aj a wa'i masanto ol ach meltzajxok och lu'umal. Yujto t'a lum ix ach koti, lum ach taxoni, yuj chi' ol ach meltzajxok och lu'umal, xchi Jehová t'a winh.
Eva ix yak' winhaj Adán sb'iok ix yetb'eyum chi', yujto t'a ix, ix pitzwi masanil anima.
Ha stz'umal nok' nok' ix sb'o Jehová Dios spichulok winh winak yet' ix yetb'eyum, ix yak'anoch spichulok heb'.

Ix yalan Jehová Dios: Ha tikne'ik, icha onh tik, icha chi' ix aj heb' anima. Tzaxo nachajel yuj heb' b'aj ay wach'il yet' chukal. Yuj chi' ay smay sloan sat te te' heb', haton te' tz'ak'an k 'inal yik pitzannhej heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Dios.
Yuj chi' ix pechjielta heb' t'a Edén chi' yuj Jehová, ix ochkan winhaj Adán chi' smunlaj t'a sat lu'um b'aj ix kot sniwanil.

Ixlajwi yelkankot heb', ix ak'jikanoch juntzanh querubín yuj Jehová t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' jun k'e'en espada tz'ititi yel sk'ak'al yek' oyoyok, yik manhxa junok mach syal yochi yik sloan sat te te' tz'ak'an k 'inal chi'.
